item.title: dotnet: AI is Changing the Cross-Platform Decision Matrix
item.description:
The post says AI agents can now rebuild a .NET MAUI app using platform-specific UI in days, which changes the tradeoffs between cross-platform and native approaches. It focuses on the build cost, maintenance cost, and runtime implications of that choice.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Managed Redis agent kit
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis agent kit is now in public preview. It adds Redis-specific guidance for building and operating production-ready Redis applications directly into AI-assisted development workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: commandline: We can build it. Can we judge it?
item.description:
The article argues that as agentic AI makes it faster to turn ideas into code, judging the resulting software becomes a more important design skill. It frames “journey evaluation” as a needed complement to rapid code generation.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
